description: Source code for the ClientCache class in Android's surfaceflinger service, managing buffer caching, process death handling, and buffer retrieval.

classes.name: ClientCache
classes.description: Manages client buffer cache, process death, and buffer lifecycle.

classes.name: ClientCache::CacheDeathRecipient
classes.description: Handles process death notifications to clean up buffers.

methods.name: ClientCache::getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer from the cache based on cacheId.

methods.name: ClientCache::add
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the cache associated with a process token and buffer id.

methods.name: ClientCache::erase
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the cache and returns the underlying GraphicBuffer.

methods.name: ClientCache::get
methods.description: Retrieves the ExternalTexture shared pointer for a given cacheId.

methods.name: ClientCache::registerErasedRecipient
methods.description: Registers a recipient to be notified when a buffer is erased.

methods.name: ClientCache::removeProcess
methods.description: Removes all buffers associated with a process token.

methods.name: ClientCache::CacheDeathRecipient::binderDied
methods.description: Callback invoked when a process dies to clean up.

methods.name: ClientCache::dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the cache for debugging.
